stages.ix_title: Select the detail that does not support the topic sentence

prompt.en: Which detail does not support this?

what_to_do.en: Tap the detail that does not fit.

stages.choice_rule: Write four short detail sentences of whole words. Exactly one does not support the topic in the stem. The other three must clearly back that topic. Keep choices kid-short and on the roots list plus allowed_extra_words. Mix school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. Vary answer_index. Use <NAME> in some stems. If a concrete noun is pictured, add media lemma for the topic, never for the miss.

gold_items.stem: A cat can be a good pet.
choices: The cat can play at home.
The cat can sit in the sun.
The cat can sleep on the bed.
Rain can fall on the street.

gold_items.stem: Rain can help the garden grow.
choices: The puppy can sleep on the bed.
The flower needs water.
Grass grows after rain.
The garden needs the rain.

gold_items.stem: Breakfast is a good morning meal.
choices: We eat toast and milk.
The kitten can climb the tree.
Fruit tastes sweet in the morning.
An egg can go on the plate.

gold_items.stem: School is a good place to learn.
choices: Kids read books in class.
The teacher can help us.
Kids eat lunch at school.
We write at our desk.
The dog barks at cars.
Mom can read a long story.
Dad can cook dinner for us.
Sister can play a game too.
They can run on the grass.
Friends play a ball game.
The swing is very fun.
Math class can be hard.

gold_items.stem: A dog can make a great pet.
choices: A dog can play with kids.
A dog barks a lot at night.
A dog can help the family.
A dog can love kids at home.

gold_items.stem: Winter days can feel very cold.
choices: Ice is on the lake.
We wear a warm coat.
The sun can shine in winter.
Snow can fall from the sky.

roots: Exactly one choice fails to support the topic stem. The other three must clearly back it.
Never write two misses or a choice that is only a label such as support or off topic.
Tier 1 misses jump to a different kid world, such as pets versus weather or food versus play.
Tier 2 misses stay in the same place or with the same people but do not back the idea.
Tier 3 misses stay on the same subject but do not back the claim.
Keep every stem and choice in kid worlds: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather.
No brands and no real names. Use <NAME> when a person is named.
One right answer. Tap only. Whole words only.

tier_rules.1: Short topic stems of five to eight words. The wrong detail is from a different kid world and is easy to spot.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level topics with two-syllable words. The wrong detail shares the place or people but does not back the idea.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss details about the same subject that do not back the claim, such as a true fact that does not help.

off_topic.en: This detail is about something else. It does not support the topic.
off_topic.ko: 이 내용은 다른 이야기입니다. 주제를 뒷받침하지 않습니다.

same_world.en: This detail is in the same place, but it does not support the topic.
same_world.ko: 같은 장소나 사람에 대한 이야기지만 주제를 뒷받침하지 않습니다.

not_support.en: This detail is about the same thing, but it does not support the topic.
not_support.ko: 같은 대상에 대한 내용이지만 주제를 뒷받침하지 않습니다.
